notes.title: Valentine's free short story + fanwork contest!
notes.content:
Hi again! Let's pretend it's "Valentine's Week" instead of Valentine's Day! So we are still in time to celebrate "Couples in Love Day" with Jorge and Ivaan, in a short pdf story you can download now from our itchio page!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41706664/c70285161994bf371a2cece1b47a7009acafffed.png[/img]

And on top of that,  guess what? We’re celebrating with a fanfic and fanart contest on our Discord!

🎉 Valentine’s Day Contest! 💖📜🎨 🎉

📌 What are the conditions?
The fanart must be inspired by Ertal Games, but crossovers are welcome! 🌹✨

📌 How to Participate?
🔹 Create a fanfic or fanart related to the game of your choice.
🔹 Submit it in the "trivia and games" channel of our Discord before the deadline.
🔹 It must be original and follow the server rules.
🔹 The submission deadline is February 20th.

🏆 Prizes
🥇 First place: An Ertal Games Steam key of your choice.
🥈 Second place: Venba Steam key.
🥉 Third place: Digital Artbook of My Burning Heart or Chasing The Stars. 

🗳️ Voting & Judging
Winners will be chosen by a voting system. The poll will start on February 21st, and we’ll announce the winners on February 24th.

💌 Let your creativity shine and celebrate love with us! 💌

notes.title: Gabriel's route is now available!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41706664/3a8cce72ef66ff987122bf706142fc5f90165a3a.png[/img]


That's right! The handsome boss route is finished!

This route adds 43k words to the game and many new illustrations! Besides, the images gallery has been checked and eight more achievements have been added.

[b]Missing features[/b] so far:

- A few lunch scenes with the other love interests are missing.

- Text messages with Gabriel are available in his route. Others might still be missing.

- An extra scene, set after the end with Gabriel, will be added soon (it was a Kickstarter request, but it doesn't fit the structure of the routes, which all finish at the same given moment).

About the missing scenes: text messages and lunch convos with other than the love interest are the "friendship route" with those characters, and follow their own storyline. That's the reason they will be added a bit later. I'm sorry for the inconvenience!

notes.title: Achievements unlocked!
notes.content:
The Steam achievements are now working properly after last night's update!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41706664/a481e62b823e80e98e4f04cd8e6bd23ff3bb2561.png[/img]

I apologize for the unexpected bugs; that's what happens when you update your engine to a more recent version just before launching a game! Everything seems to be working fine, when boom! Incompatible features strike again!

That said, after another round of thorough testing, it seems there aren't any bugs left in the game, but of course, if you find one don't hesitate to let me know. There's a pinned post in the Community page of the game for that use ;)

Your saved games might not be working due to the change of engine versions: my sincere apology! Remember you can use the "Skip" mode to run the game again until the point you previously were at.

notes.title: Warning: change of rating of the game
notes.content:
That's right! We have listened to your feedback and the Steam version of the game is now the full, uncensored one!

However, if you are not yet over the legal age to see that kind of content in your country, or if you rather not see explicit stuff, we have added the option to choose between the censored and the uncensored versions at the start of the game. So now it's up to you!

notes.title: Exes Assault! is no longer wonky wonky!
notes.content:
Yes, that's right! Everything is finally working as it should!

Blame the nerves of the release day: while all worked fine on our side before uploading the game to Steam, the moment we hit the "release" button everything seemed to go downhill! Fortunately, all is fixed now and you can enjoy your game to your heart's content!

Please, follow us on our social media (Twitter/ X or Discord) to get frequent updates and news about Exes Assault!!

notes.title: Update fixing images path not found
notes.content:
Hi,

Some players are finding an annoying error at the start of the game; it's a series of error screens that can be simply ignored, but I'd rather make a new build with those error screens out.

The bug itself will be solved in a few hours. Please, allow us some time to test again what went wrong.

Remember that in games made in renpy you can save your game and then, when a new patch is available, you simply need to either load your saved game, or start anew but playing on "Skip" mode: it will quickly advance until it finds any scene or line you haven't seen yet, so you don't miss a single thing!

notes.title: Exes Assault!! is in Early Access!
notes.content:
Ooops, it seems we went slightly out of scope with the game!  The final version will be longer, with more illustrations, and with more features than we initially planned. And that's a good thing, right?! However, that means we are behind schedule, and that's not so good. I feel bad for making people wait so much without a release date in view.

Hence, we have decided to put the game on Early Access, to share the two available routes so far. Let's check what is ready to play right now!

The Early Access version of Exes Assault!! features:

* Jacob and Ivaan's routes.

* 150k words.

* Many cutscene illustrations.

* Business trips, dates, and a waterpark special event!

* Chat with the potential boyfriends and get closer to them!

* English only.

For the full version, we are planning on:

* Gabriel and Kevin's routes.

* A polyamory route with Jacob and Gabriel.

* Full translation into Spanish and Catalan (and maybe more languages).

Gabriel's route is currently 60% done, so keep tuned for updates! Consider following us on Twitter/ X or Discord to get more frequent news about the game!

notes.title: Successful Kickstarter campaign!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41706664/d65d18eb97631020011bb7b0cfccd02057c22a1f.png[/img]

Our crowdfunding campaign finished yesterday, and I'd like to take this chance to offer my most sincere thank you to each and every one who helped, be it by pledging or by sharing the word. For a small indie team like mine, which consists of a single person managing almost everything and a few talented freelancers, KS is the only way we can keep on making BL games: we don't have a publisher funding our games or helping with promotion, so all you see it's just our hard work.

Besides funding Exes Assault!!, we unlocked two stretch goals: a pole dancing scene and a polyamory route! I hope you are excited about them ;)

And sadly, we didn't reach the full voice acting goal, but we'll be adding partial voice acting to the game!
